# Command line

`omega` (or `python3 -m omega_transform`) takes a command. Commands that inspect a run take its run directory; program ids may be abbreviated to a unique prefix.

## `check`

Validate a problem: evaluate the initial program, check the model (exit 1: the problem is broken; 3: only the model is unusable).

```text
omega check [-h] config
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `config` | omega.toml or the problem directory |

## `run`

Start or resume a search.

```text
omega run [-h] [--run-dir RUN_DIR] [-n ITERATIONS] [--minutes MINUTES] [-m MODEL] [--openrouter MODEL] [--max-cost-usd MAX_COST_USD] [-j EVAL_JOBS] [--llm-jobs LLM_JOBS] [--think | --no-think] [--reserve-gb RESERVE_GB] [--skip-check] config
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `config` | omega.toml or the problem directory |
| `--run-dir` | run directory (reuse one to resume; default: runs/&lt;time&gt; in the problem directory) |
| `-n, --iterations` | model answers to run (overrides search.iterations) |
| `--minutes` | time limit (overrides search.max_minutes) |
| `-m, --model` | override models (repeatable) |
| `--openrouter` | use this OpenRouter model (cloud; repeatable, combines with -m) |
| `--max-cost-usd` | stop once the run's model requests cost this much (llm.max_cost_usd) |
| `-j, --eval-jobs` | parallel evaluation jobs |
| `--llm-jobs` | parallel LLM requests |
| `--think / --no-think` | enable/disable model reasoning (ollama think flag) |
| `--reserve-gb` | RAM to keep free; a model that would not fit is not loaded Default: `6.0`. |
| `--skip-check` | do not verify the model first (installed, fits in memory) |

## `status`

Summary of a run.

```text
omega status [-h] [--top TOP] run_dir
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `run_dir` | run directory |
| `--top` | leaderboard length Default: `10`. |

## `stats`

Success rates by strategy, LLM time, best over time.

```text
omega stats [-h] run_dir
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `run_dir` | run directory |

## `replay`

Re-send logged prompts with other LLM settings.

```text
omega replay [-h] [-n N] [--ids IDS [IDS ...]] [-m MODEL] [--think | --no-think] [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--evaluate] [--seed SEED] run_dir
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `run_dir` | run directory |
| `-n` | number of most recent prompts Default: `6`. |
| `--ids` | specific program ids instead |
| `-m, --model` | model to use (repeatable) |
| `--think / --no-think` | enable/disable model reasoning |
| `--temperature` | sampling temperature |
| `--evaluate` | also evaluate applicable answers |
| `--seed` | random seed for model choice |

## `bench`

Compare Ollama models on the examples (long-running).

```text
omega bench [-h] [--examples EXAMPLES [EXAMPLES ...]] [--models MODELS [MODELS ...]] [--exclude EXCLUDE [EXCLUDE ...]] [--max-size-gb MAX_SIZE_GB] [--minutes MINUTES] [--think | --no-think] [--out OUT] [--runs RUNS] [--report REPORT] [--base-url BASE_URL] [--wait-ram-minutes WAIT_RAM_MINUTES] [--reserve-gb RESERVE_GB] [--openrouter MODEL [MODEL ...]] [--no-local] [--max-cost-usd MAX_COST_USD] [--feasible FILE] [--dry-run]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--examples` | problem directories Default: `examples/circle_packing examples/matmul_st_cpp`. |
| `--models` | model names or 'all' Default: `all`. |
| `--exclude` | model names to leave out |
| `--max-size-gb` | skip models whose weights exceed this size (default 22) Default: `22.0`. |
| `--minutes` | search budget per run Default: `15.0`. |
| `--think / --no-think` | enable/disable model reasoning |
| `--out` | result JSON directory (commit it) Default: `bench/results`. |
| `--runs` | full run directories (local) Default: `bench/runs`. |
| `--report` | overview page regenerated after each run, with its sub-pages Default: `docs/benchmarks.md`. |
| `--base-url` | Ollama server (default http://localhost:11434) |
| `--wait-ram-minutes` | wait up to this long for memory before each model instead of skipping it (other applications free memory over time) |
| `--reserve-gb` | RAM to keep free; checked before every run, models that would not fit are skipped Default: `6.0`. |
| `--openrouter` | also benchmark these OpenRouter models (cloud; needs a key) |
| `--no-local` | no local models: only the --openrouter models |
| `--max-cost-usd` | stop an OpenRouter run once its requests cost this much Default: `1.0`. |
| `--feasible` | only models marked ok in this `omega models` result file |
| `--dry-run` | only list what would run |

## `bench-details`

Add the best program's lineage and diff to benchmark result files written before they were recorded.

```text
omega bench-details [-h] [--results RESULTS] [--runs RUNS]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--results` | result JSON directory Default: `bench/results`. |
| `--runs` | the run directories behind them Default: `bench/runs`. |

## `bench-solutions`

Add the drawable solutions of the initial and best program to each example's best benchmark result, by evaluating both again (for results written before they were recorded).

```text
omega bench-solutions [-h] [--results RESULTS] [--runs RUNS] [--examples EXAMPLES]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--results` | result JSON directory Default: `bench/results`. |
| `--runs` | the run directories behind them Default: `bench/runs`. |
| `--examples` | the example problems Default: `examples`. |

## `models`

Quick check whether installed models load and work.

```text
omega models [-h] [--models MODELS [MODELS ...]] [--max-size-gb MAX_SIZE_GB] [--wait-ram-minutes WAIT_RAM_MINUTES] [--reserve-gb RESERVE_GB] [--min-tokens-per-s MIN_TOKENS_PER_S] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--openrouter MODEL [MODEL ...]] [--out OUT] [--base-url BASE_URL]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--models` | only these models (default: all installed) |
| `--max-size-gb` | do not load models whose weights exceed this size Default: `22.0`. |
| `--wait-ram-minutes` | wait up to this long for memory before each model instead of skipping it (other applications free memory over time) |
| `--reserve-gb` | RAM to keep free for the system, evaluation jobs and other applications; models that would not fit are not loaded Default: `6.0`. |
| `--min-tokens-per-s` | generation speed below which a model is marked slow Default: `8.0`. |
| `--timeout` | seconds to wait for a model to load and answer (first loads from a slow disk, or with a format migration, can take minutes) Default: `900.0`. |
| `--openrouter` | also check these OpenRouter models (cloud; a few small paid requests) |
| `--out` | result file read by `bench --feasible` Default: `bench/model-check.json`. |
| `--base-url` | Ollama server (default http://localhost:11434) |

## `sandbox`

Show which sandbox jobs run in on this machine.

```text
omega sandbox [-h]
```

## `report`

Render bench results into the docs page.

```text
omega report [-h] [--results RESULTS] [-o OUTPUT] [--openrouter-snapshots OPENROUTER_SNAPSHOTS]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--results` | result JSON directory Default: `bench/results`. |
| `-o, --output` | overview page to write; its sub-pages go to the directory of the same name Default: `docs/benchmarks.md`. |
| `--openrouter-snapshots` | OpenRouter snapshots; the newest becomes docs/openrouter-models.md Default: `bench/openrouter`. |

## `model-releases`

Fill in when each benchmarked model was released (Hugging Face and OpenRouter; for the timeline per developer).

```text
omega model-releases [-h] [--file FILE] [--results RESULTS]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--file` | release dates; local models need their Hugging Face repository there Default: `bench/model-releases.json`. |
| `--results` | result JSON directory Default: `bench/results`. |

## `openrouter-snapshot`

Record OpenRouter's most used models with their prices.

```text
omega openrouter-snapshot [-h] [--out OUT]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--out` | snapshot directory (commit it) Default: `bench/openrouter`. |

## `best`

Print or save the best program.

```text
omega best [-h] [-o OUTPUT] run_dir
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `run_dir` | run directory |
| `-o, --output` | write to this file instead of standard output |

## `lineage`

The chain of ideas that led to a program.

```text
omega lineage [-h] run_dir [id]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `run_dir` | run directory |
| `id` | program id (default: the best) Default: `best`. |

## `show`

Details and diff of one program.

```text
omega show [-h] [--code] run_dir [id]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `run_dir` | run directory |
| `id` | program id (default: the best) Default: `best`. |
| `--code` | full code instead of the diff |

## `journal`

Recent attempts.

```text
omega journal [-h] [-n N] [--island ISLAND] run_dir
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `run_dir` | run directory |
| `-n` | number of attempts Default: `40`. |
| `--island` | only this island |

## `notebook`

The current lessons notebook.

```text
omega notebook [-h] run_dir
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `run_dir` | run directory |

## `docs`

Regenerate the reference pages from the code.

```text
omega docs [-h] [--check]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--check` | only report whether the committed pages are current (exit 1 if not) |
